units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 8. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish requirements for the form and content of the report on the volume of procurement of goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons; the procedure for generating and publishing it in the unified information system and on the official website; the procedure for granting the federal executive body specified in part 7 of this Article access to information in such reports published in the unified information system; and the procedure for that body to examine those reports and evaluate the results of procurement of goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons during the reporting year. To ensure national defence and state security, the Government of the Russian Federation may establish cases where such a report is not to be published in the unified information system, and the procedure for sending it in those cases to the federal executive body specified in part 7 of this Article.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 9. This Article shall not apply to procurement of goods, works and services by foreign intelligence bodies of the Russian Federation and bodies of the Federal Security Service to ensure state security; by state protection bodies to implement state protection measures; or by troops of the National Guard of the Russian Federation to carry out their tasks of participation in combating terrorism and extremism, and, by decision of the President of the Russian Federation, to ensure the security of the highest officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (heads of their highest executive bodies) and other persons.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 1. Budget-funded institutions shall conduct procurement using subsidies provided from budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation and other funds in accordance with this Federal Law, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 2. Where a budget-funded institution has adopted a legal act under part 3 of Article 2 of Federal Law of 18 July 2011 No. 223-FZ “On Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities” and published it in the unified information system before the start of the year, that institution may, during that year and subject to the requirements of that Federal Law and legal act, conduct procurement:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 1) using funds received as gifts, including donations (charitable donations), by will, as grants transferred gratuitously and irrevocably by citizens and legal entities, including foreign citizens and foreign legal entities, and by international organizations entitled to award grants in the Russian Federation in the manner established by legislation of the Russian Federation, or as subsidies (grants) awarded competitively from the relevant budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, unless the conditions set by grantors provide otherwise;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 2) as the performing party under a contract, where, during performance of that contract, it engages other persons under an agreement to supply goods, perform works or provide services necessary for performance of the institution’s obligations under the contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 3) using funds received from individuals and legal entities through its other income-generating activities, including the principal activities specified in its founding document, except funds received for the provision and payment of medical care under compulsory medical insurance.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 2.1. State and municipal unitary enterprises shall conduct procurement in accordance with this Federal Law, except for:
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 1) procurement by federal state unitary enterprises of substantial importance for safeguarding the rights and lawful interests of citizens of the Russian Federation and the state’s defence capability and security, the list of which is approved by the Government of the Russian Federation in agreement with the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation, where such procurement is conducted without using subsidies from the federal budget for capital investment in capital construction projects constituting state property of the Russian Federation within the Russian Federation and/or for acquisition of immovable property within the Russian Federation into state ownership of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 2) procurement conducted under a legal act provided for by part 3 of Article 2 of Federal Law of 18 July 2011 No. 223-FZ “On Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities”, adopted by a state or municipal unitary enterprise and published in the unified information system before the start of the year:
units.label: Point 2 Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: а) using funds received as gifts, including donations, by will, as grants transferred gratuitously and irrevocably by citizens and legal entities, including foreign citizens and foreign legal entities, and by international organizations entitled to award grants in the Russian Federation in the manner established by legislation of the Russian Federation, or as subsidies (grants) awarded competitively from the relevant budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, unless the conditions set by grantors provide otherwise;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: б) as the performing party under a contract, where, during performance of that contract, it engages other persons under an agreement to supply goods, perform works or provide services necessary for performance of the enterprise’s obligations under the contract, except where the enterprise is performing a contract concluded under points 2 and 6.1 of part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: в) without using funds from the relevant budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 3. A decision made by a budget-funded institution or a state or municipal unitary enterprise to conduct the procurement specified, respectively, in points 1–3 of part 2 and subpoints “а”–“в” of point 2 of part 2.1 of this Article in the manner established by this Federal Law or in accordance with Federal Law of 18 July 2011 No. 223-FZ “On Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities” may not be changed during the current year, unless otherwise established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 4. Where legal entities conduct procurement using funds provided from budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation whose conditions of provision, under budget legislation of the Russian Federation, require compliance with this Federal Law, the provisions of this Federal Law governing the relations specified in points 2, 3, 5 and 6 and in point 7, insofar as it concerns procurement control under part 3 of Article 99 of this Federal Law, of part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law shall apply. Where autonomous institutions plan and conduct procurement using funds provided from budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation for capital investment in state or municipal property, the provisions of this Federal Law governing the relations specified in points 1–3 and 5–7 of part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law shall apply.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 4.1. Repealed from 1 January 2025. — Federal Law of 29.05.2024 No. 124-FZ.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 4.2. The public-law company “Unified Contracting Authority in Construction” shall conduct procurement using federal budget funds for engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction, major repairs and demolition of capital construction projects in accordance with its programme of activities for the current year and planning period, subject to the requirements of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4.2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 4.3. Where the Fund for the Preservation and Development of the Solovetsky Archipelago is granted subsidies provided for by point 2 of Article 78.1 of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation in accordance with budget legislation of the Russian Federation, its procurement using those subsidies shall be subject to the provisions of this Federal Law governing the relations specified in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4.3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 4.4. Where joint-stock companies whose shares are wholly owned by a constituent entity of the Russian Federation conduct procurement to fulfil obligations under contracts concluded under point 6.1 of part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law, those companies shall be subject to the provisions of this Federal Law governing the relations specified in points 2–6 and point 7, insofar as it concerns procurement control under part 3 of Article 99 of this Federal Law, of part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4.4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 5. Repealed from 1 January 2025. — Federal Law of 29.05.2024 No. 124-FZ.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 6. Where, in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds, local self-government bodies, the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom” or the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos”, acting as state or municipal contracting authorities, have, when making budgetary investments in capital construction projects that are state or municipal property and/or acquiring immovable property into state or municipal ownership, gratuitously transferred their powers as a state or municipal contracting authority by agreement to budget-funded institutions, autonomous institutions, state or municipal unitary enterprises or other legal entities, those institutions, unitary enterprises or legal entities shall, within the transferred powers, procure goods, works and services on behalf of those bodies or state corporations in accordance with the provisions of this Federal Law governing the activities of state and municipal contracting authorities.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Special rules for procurement by budget-funded and autonomous institutions, state and municipal unitary enterprises and other legal entities
units.text: 7. Where legislation of the Russian Federation requires tenders or auctions to be held, or other methods for selecting a supplier (contractor, service provider) to be used under this Federal Law, in order to conclude a civil-law agreement (contract) within relations not specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law, Articles 14, 23, 28–30, 34 and 35 of this Federal Law shall not apply to those procedures, unless otherwise provided by legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 15

units.text: Chapter 2. PLANNING
units.label: Chapter 2. PLANNING

units.text: Article 16. Procurement planning
units.label: Art. 16

units.text: 1. Procurement shall be planned through the preparation, approval and maintenance of schedules. Procurement not provided for in the schedules may not be conducted.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.text: 2. Schedules shall include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 1) procurement identification codes determined in accordance with Article 23 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 2) the name of the procurement subject matter and/or the names of the procurement subject matters;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 3) the amount of funding for procurement;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 4) the time limits (frequency) for conducting planned procurement;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 5) information on public discussion of procurement under Article 20 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 6) other information specified by the procedure provided for by point 2 of part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 1) requirements for the form of schedules;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 2) the procedure for preparing and approving schedules and amending them;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 3) the procedure for publishing schedules in the unified information system and on the official website.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 4. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish special rules for including in a schedule information on centralized procurement, joint tenders and auctions, procurement using closed methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers), and certain procurement provided for by subpoint “г” of point 2 of part 10 of Article 24, part 1 of Article 93, and Articles 111 and 111.4 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 16

units.text: 5. Schedules shall be prepared for a period corresponding to the period of validity of the federal law on the federal budget for the next financial year and planning period; federal laws on the budgets of state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation for the next financial year and planning period; the law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on its budget; laws of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the budgets of territorial state extrabudgetary funds; or the municipal legal act of the representative body of a municipal entity on the local budget. Taking account of budget legislation of the Russian Federation, schedules shall include information on procurement planned for after the planning period. In that case, the information specified in part 2 of this Article shall be entered in the procurement schedules for the entire duration of the planned procurement.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 16

units.text: 6. A state or municipal contracting authority shall prepare a schedule in accordance with this Article during the preparation and examination of draft budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, taking account of budget legislation of the Russian Federation. The schedule shall be approved within ten working days after the amount, expressed in monetary terms, of the authority’s entitlement to assume and/or discharge obligations under budget legislation of the Russian Federation is communicated to it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 16

units.text: 7. State and municipal institutions and state and municipal unitary enterprises shall prepare schedules in accordance with this Article when planning their financial and economic activities. Schedules shall be approved within ten working days after approval, respectively, of the financial and economic activity plan of the state or municipal institution or the financial and economic activity plan (programme) of the state or municipal unitary enterprise.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 16

units.text: 8. Schedules shall be amended where necessary:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 1) to bring them into conformity following changes to requirements established under Article 19 of this Federal Law for goods, works or services procured by contracting authorities, including their maximum prices, and/or standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 2) to bring them into conformity following changes to the amount, expressed in monetary terms, of the contracting authority’s entitlement to assume and/or discharge obligations under budget legislation of the Russian Federation, changes to indicators in financial and economic activity plans (programmes) of state or municipal institutions or state or municipal unitary enterprises, or changes to the relevant decisions and/or agreements on the provision of subsidies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 3) to implement a decision taken by the contracting authority following public discussion of procurement under Article 20 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 4) to use savings achieved in procurement in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 5) in other cases established by the procedure provided for by point 2 of part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Point 5 Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 9. Amendments to a schedule under part 8 of this Article may be made no later than one day before publication in the unified information system of the relevant procurement notice or the sending of an invitation to participate in a closed method for selecting a supplier (contractor, service provider); or, where a contract is concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law, no later than one day before conclusion of the contract.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 16

units.text: 10. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 16

units.text: 11. Special rules for procurement planning under the state defence order are established by Federal Law of 29 December 2012 No. 275-FZ “On the State Defence Order”.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 16

units.text: Article 17. Repealed
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.text: Article 17. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Art. 17

units.text: Article 18. Justification of procurement
units.label: Art. 18

units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Federal Law, procurement conducted in accordance with Articles 19 and 22 of this Federal Law shall be considered justified.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.text: 2 - 3. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18 · “2 - 3. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of…”

units.text: 4. Whether procurement is justified shall be assessed during procurement audit and procurement control under this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 18

units.text: 5. A particular procurement may be found unjustified as a result of procurement audit or procurement control.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 18

units.text: 6. Where planned procurement is found unjustified, the control bodies specified in point 3 of part 1 of Article 99 of this Federal Law shall issue orders to remedy identified violations of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, and shall hold persons responsible for violations of this Federal Law administratively liable in the manner established by the Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 18

units.text: 7. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 18

units.text: Article 19. Setting standards in procurement
units.label: Art. 19

units.text: 1. Setting standards in procurement means establishing requirements for goods, works or services procured by a contracting authority, including their maximum prices, and/or standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, including their respective territorial bodies and subordinate treasury institutions, but excluding treasury institutions assigned, in the prescribed manner, a state (municipal) assignment for the provision of state (municipal) services or performance of works.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.text: 2. For the purposes of this Article, requirements for goods, works and services procured by a contracting authority mean requirements for their quantity, consumer properties, including quality characteristics, and other characteristics that enable state and municipal needs to be met without leading to procurement of goods, works or services with excessive consumer properties or classified as luxury items under legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish general rules for setting standards in procurement to meet state and municipal needs, including:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19

units.text: 1) general requirements for drafting and adopting legal acts on procurement standards, their content and ensuring their implementation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 19
